sentences.text:
Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
-----
 For Petitioner : M/s. S. A. Ansari, Advocate
 For the State : M/s. S. K. Jha, A.P.P
 ---
 04/10.11.2023 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 12/2021, registered under Sections 376 (2)
(n)/ 323/ 313/417/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Ms. Shardha Bhushan,
learned J.M.F.C., Ranchi.
The prosecutrix had entered into sexual relationship with the petitioner on the pretext of marriage.
Subsequently the petitioner got employed in Bhubaneswar.
When the informant and her family members requested the petitioner to marry her the petitioner refused to marry her.
Thereafter the petitioner married elsewhere accordingly this case was instituted in the year 2021.
The prosecutrix had remained in a prolonged sexual relationship with the petitioner for 6 years.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Ms. Shardha Bhushan, learned J.M.F.C.,
Ranchi or his successor in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 12/2021.
